source: 需要管理员权限
en: Administrator access required

source: 以管理员身份继续
en: Continue as admin

source: Process Keeper需要管理员权限，才能完整查看应用进程并执行你确认的操作。
en: Process Keeper needs administrator access to view all app processes and carry out actions you approve.

source: 由你确认授权
en: You approve access

source: 点击继续后，Windows 将显示用户账户控制提示。
en: Select Continue as admin to open the Windows permission prompt.

source: 尚未开始管理进程
en: No processes are managed yet

source: 当前页面不会采集、关闭或重启其他应用。
en: This page does not scan, close or restart other apps.

source: 从原始程序安全启动
en: Use the original launcher

source: 授权后会重新打开Process Keeper，并进入首次使用引导。
en: After approval, Process Keeper will reopen and continue setup.

source: 请关闭此窗口，再打开下载的原始单文件「ProcessKeeper.exe」。
en: Close this window and open your downloaded portable ProcessKeeper.exe.

source: 准备就绪
en: Ready to go

source: 初次使用
en: Getting started

source: 开始使用
en: Get started

source: 继续
en: Continue

source: 欢迎使用Process Keeper
en: Welcome to Process Keeper

source: 看清正在运行的应用，留下需要的程序，再确认关闭其他程序。
en: See what's running, keep the apps you need, and review the rest before closing them.

source: 先看应用，再看进程
en: From apps to processes

source: 单击应用可展开关联进程，查看前台、隐藏后台和占用情况。
en: Expand an app to see its processes, window state and memory use.

source: 重要应用加入白名单
en: Keep important apps

source: 受保护的应用会保留，关闭前仍可检查本次操作。
en: Add apps to the whitelist and review each close operation before confirming.

source: 在本机完成
en: Everything stays local

source: 运行信息与规则保存在本地；测试版本不代表最终品质。
en: Process data and rules stay on this PC. This test build does not represent final quality.

source: 运行信息与规则保存在本地。
en: Process data and rules stay on this PC.

source: 把需要的应用留下
en: Keep the apps you need

source: 正在运行或已经安装的应用，都可以加入白名单。
en: Add running or installed apps to your whitelist.

source: 随时添加或调整
en: Update your choices anytime

source: 从运行中程序、已安装程序或白名单页，选择需要保留的应用。
en: Choose apps from Running apps, Installed apps or Whitelist.

source: 规则可带到另一台电脑
en: Move rules between PCs

source: 导入后只匹配本机实际存在的应用；仍需核对匹配结果。
en: Imported rules match apps available on this PC. Review the matches before use.

source: 设置也能备份
en: Back up your preferences

source: 在设置中导入或导出规则与设置，分享前可检查文件内容。
en: Import or export rules and preferences in Settings. Review files before sharing.

source: 让隐藏的页面出现
en: Bring hidden windows back

source: 展开进程后查看能力标签，再选择「打开对应页面」。
en: Expand an app, check the process labels, then choose Open app window.

source: 先尝试恢复现有窗口
en: Restore existing windows first

source: 虚拟机、无界面浏览器和托盘程序会使用对应的适配方式。
en: Virtual machines, headless browsers and tray apps use supported recovery methods.

source: 需要重启时先询问
en: Confirm before restarting

source: AVD 等操作会说明影响，只有你确认后才会执行。
en: Actions such as restarting an AVD explain their impact and wait for your approval.

source: 以实际图形页面为准
en: Look for a real app window

source: 标签表示可尝试的能力；只有命令行窗口不算页面成功打开。
en: Labels show what can be attempted. A command window alone is not a successful recovery.

source: 准备好了，开始使用
en: You're ready to get started

source: 建议先检查白名单，再进行第一次关闭操作。
en: Review your whitelist before closing apps for the first time.

source: 三个列表，统一更新
en: Three lists, one update setting

source: 三页的实时更新开关共用设置，操作记录始终实时。
en: Live updates share one setting across all three lists. Activity history always stays live.

source: 给内容多留一点空间
en: Make room for your apps

source: 侧边栏左上角的菜单按钮可将导航收起为图标。
en: Use the menu button at the top of the sidebar to collapse navigation to icons.

source: 按你的习惯调整
en: Make it yours

source: 主题与背景材质在设置里调整，操作记录会实时保留。
en: Adjust the theme and background material in Settings. Actions are recorded as they happen.

source: 已取消管理员授权，可以再次尝试。
en: Administrator access was cancelled. You can try again.

source: 启动入口已不可用，请重新打开原始单文件「ProcessKeeper.exe」。
en: The launcher is no longer available. Reopen your original portable ProcessKeeper.exe.

source: 未能以管理员身份启动，请重试或重新打开原始单文件「ProcessKeeper.exe」。
en: Could not start as administrator. Try again or reopen your original portable ProcessKeeper.exe.

source: 未能完成管理员授权，请重试。
en: Could not complete administrator approval. Please try again.

source: 仍然开始使用
en: Continue anyway

source: 引导记录未保存。本次仍可继续，下次打开可能再次显示介绍。
en: Setup progress could not be saved. You can continue, but this introduction may appear again next time.

source: 返回
en: Back

source: 退出
en: Exit

source: 无法读取引导记录，将重新显示介绍。
en: Could not read setup progress. The introduction will be shown again.

source: 选择你的语言
en: Choose your language

source: 选择后立即应用。稍后也可在设置中更改。
en: Your choice applies immediately. You can change it later in Settings.

source: 自动跟随系统
en: Follow system automatically

source: 优先系统显示语言，结合地区与时区判断。
en: Uses the Windows display language first, with region and time zone as hints.

source: 语言已临时应用，但无法保存；下次启动可能恢复原语言。
en: Language changed for this session but could not be saved. The previous language may return next time.
